Onboarding checklist

Edited by Dana Okafor2 days ago6 min read

Everything a new teammate needs in their first two weeks. Work through it with your onboarding buddy and tick items off as you go.

Before day one

Laptop ordered and shipped to home address
Accounts created for email, chat and the code host
Buddy assigned and intro call booked

First week

Read “How we work” and leave one comment
Ship a small change to the handbook itself
